ayahs.1: Those who rejected the truth among the People of the Book and the mushrikun were not going to leave their ways until a bayyinah—a clear, undeniable proof—came to them:
ayahs.2: a messenger from Allah reciting purified scriptures—
ayahs.3: containing upright commands that cut through inherited confusion.
ayahs.4: Yet when that proof came, they divided—because accepting it would cost pride, profit, and old alliances.
ayahs.5: They were commanded only to worship Allah with sincere devotion, establish salah, and give zakat. That is the upright deen.
ayahs.6: Those who reject among the People of the Book and the mushrikun are in the Fire of Jahannam, abiding forever. They are the worst of creation in outcome.
ayahs.7: Those who believe and do righteous deeds—they are the best of creation in outcome.
ayahs.8: Their reward with their Lord is Gardens of eternity with rivers flowing beneath—abiding forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. That is for whoever holds taqwa before his Lord.
